table.name: TLGNR_TRUCK_TYPE_TRSP_CAT_BS
table.description: Maps truck transport categories to the truck types that usually have these categories. When scheduling an order to a truck, we check if that truck's transport category fits the order material. When the order is initially created, we cannot perform that check yet, since we don't know the actual truck that will be used. To limit the selectable truck types in the order anyway, this table is used. The material selected in the order determines the required transport category, and this table will be used to see which truck types (usually) provide this category. Implemented as a reference data because of caching and because it need not be written in any business use case.

column.name: TRUCK_TYPE_TRSP_CAT_CD
column.description: PK. Identifies which transport categories are usually supported by a truck type.

column.name: TRUCK_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_truck_type_bs. The truck type being mapped.

column.name: TRUCK_TRANSPORT_CAT_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_truck_transport_cat_bs. The truck transport category being mapped.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
